company: Ministerio de Ambiente, Vivienda y Desarrollo Territorial
card_says: Described in the present tense as 'the Colombian environment, housing and territorial development ministry', which ran the project through its vice-ministry for water and sanitation.
source_says: That combined ministry no longer exists. Law 1444 of 2011 split off its housing, land-use and water and sanitation functions to a new Ministry of Housing, City and Territory, which took over the water and sanitation vice-ministry, and renamed the remainder the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development. The ministry held the water and sanitation vice-ministry at the time of the case; from 2011 it did not.

source.title: Decreto 3570 de 2011
source.publisher: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, Colombia

company: Fondo Financiero de Proyectos de Desarrollo (FONADE)
card_says: Named as FONADE, 'the Colombian state development project financing agency', which administered the sub-projects.
source_says: It carried the FONADE name at the time of the case; Decree 495 of 2019 renamed it Empresa Nacional Promotora del Desarrollo Territorial (ENTerritorio).

company: Aguas de La Guajira S.A. E.S.P.
card_says: Named as the operator of the Riohacha water supply system, in a 2011 resettlement plan about events of 2001-2006.
source_says: It operated under that name at the time of those events; the regulator records that its majority shares were sold on 13 September 2014 and the company was renamed Avanzadas Soluciones de Acueducto y Alcantarillado S.A. E.S.P. (ASAA).

source.title: Evaluación integral de prestadores: Avanzadas Soluciones de Acueducto y Alcantarillado S.A. E.S.P. (Riohacha)
source.publisher: Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios, Colombia

company: Agence Djiboutienne d'Execution des Travaux d'Interet Public (ADETIP)
card_says: 'In 2007 Parliament widened its mandate to the National Initiative for Human Development and it was renamed Agence Djiboutienne de Developpement Social (ADDS), into which ADETIP was folded.'
source_says: ADDS's own site dates its establishment to Decree No. 0025 of 8 January 2008, and describes ADDS as the result of a merger of ADETIP with the Social Development Fund rather than a renaming of ADETIP alone; a 2007 parliamentary step and a 2008 founding decree are not inconsistent, but the card's year and the 'renamed' wording do not match the agency's own account.

company: Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure (MOICI), The Gambia
card_says: Named as the ministry made responsible by the resettlement plan for carrying it out, through the state telecommunications company.
source_says: The ministry held that name at the time; in 2022 MOICI was split into the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy and the Ministry of Information.

source.title: MOCDE Infographic
source.publisher: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy, The Gambia

card_says: Named as North Macedonia's national road agency and the implementing body for the road upgrade, with its Director as project coordinator.
source_says: It held that role at the time; a law of 27 December 2012 replaced it with the Public Enterprise for State Roads, which took over its staff, assets and archives. The same page names the 2008 body the 'Agency for Public Roads' and the 2012 predecessor the 'Agency for State Roads', without explaining the change of name.

source.title: History

card_says: The entity is spelled 'Office de Voirie et Drainage'.
source_says: Congolese and donor documents give the body's name as 'Office des Voiries et Drainage' (OVD), and place it inside the Ministry of Infrastructure, Public Works and Reconstruction.

card_says: The entity is spelled 'Comité Permanent d'Acquisitions à l'Amiable' and called the Haitian government's land acquisition committee.
source_says: World Bank resettlement documents for Haiti give the name as 'Comité Permanent d'Acquisition à l'Amiable' (CPA), singular, and place it at the Ministry of Economy and Finance rather than at the Ministry of Public Works, which instructs it after a public-utility declaration.

source.title: Cadre de politique de réinstallation, Haiti Digital Acceleration Project (P171976)

company: Housing Fund of the Ministry of Urban Development, Djibouti
card_says: The fund is attached to a 'Ministry of Urban Development'.
source_says: Djiboutian housing policy is reported as sitting with a delegate ministry at the Ministry of Habitat, Urban Planning and Environment in charge of Housing, created in 2011; the Fonds de l'Habitat is one of its two implementing arms and was being relaunched as the Agency for Urban Rehabilitation and Social Housing.

source.title: Home improvement: the provision of housing remains a critical component of development plans (The Report: Djibouti 2018)
